Since the petitioner has no criminal antecedents and there appears to be no possibility fleeing from justice, this Court extends the benefit of anticipatory bail to the petitioner with stringent conditions subject to his furnishing personal bonds for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:166288 Arresting/Investigating Officer.

However, the petitioner shall join investigation as and when called upon to do so and cooperate with the Arresting/Investigating Officer and shall abide by the conditions as provided under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
In case the petitioner does not join the investigation, the State is free to move an application for cancellation of his bail.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner, who has no criminal antecedents,
apprehends his arrest in respect of the offences of criminal breach of trust and cheating in case FIR No. 214 dated 14.10.2024 under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code registered at Police Station Division No. 6, Police Commissionerate, Ludhiana, which arise out of a cheque for an amount of Rs. 1,44,042/- issued by the petitioner being dishonoured.
2. The facts further reveal that the aforesaid cheque was issued for payment of zinc ingot plates and caustic soda flakes purchased by the petitioner and therefore, the entire transactions appears to have civil overtones.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Since the petitioner has no criminal antecedents and there appears to be no possibility fleeing from justice, this Court extends the benefit of anticipatory bail to the petitioner with stringent conditions subject to his furnishing personal bonds for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:166288 Arresting/Investigating Officer.
However, the petitioner shall join investigation as and when called upon to do so and cooperate with the Arresting/Investigating Officer and shall abide by the conditions as provided under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
In case the petitioner does not join the investigation, the State is free to move an application for cancellation of his bail.
This order shall also remain subject to the following condition:-
i) The petitioner shall plant 10 saplings of indigenous plants at a public place and submit proof in that regard by way of photographs before the concerned Police Station where the FIR has been registered within a period of 15 days and if there is no such intimation submitted or intimation is found to be incorrect, then the State can move an application for cancellation of his bail.
4.
The petition stands allowed.
